title: Chevrons toggle closed on a second click and every customer's and asset's expansion is independent
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. At least two customers with assets are in the current view.
steps: 1. Expand customer A, then expand one of its assets.
expected: 1. Each chevron toggles back to collapsed on a second activation.
2. Collapsing customer A does not affect customer B's expansion.
3. Each asset's expansion state is likewise independent.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
